outcome: Detection rate of adnexal masses by ultrasonography
Maternal and fetal complications related to surgery
cohort: Patients who underwent cesarean section at Women's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine, Hangzhou, China, from January 1991 to December 2011
finding: The incidence of adnexal masses during cesarean section was 16.40 per 1000, with benign ovarian tumor being the most common diagnosis, and only 29.78% of cases detected preoperatively by ultrasonography.
